verdict.rationale: Brex publishes a documented developer platform (developer.brex.com) with multiple named REST APIs (Accounting, Budgets, Webhooks, Team, Expenses, Payments, Transactions), a quickstart guide for making API calls, and an llms.txt confirming the API documentation structure — clear evidence of a documented public API for driving the product programmatically. Missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (all candidate paths 404'd) and independent developer corroboration of real-world API usage/reliability.
